name: Oba
aliases: Oba, the central dryad of Trostani
description: Oba is the dryad of Life, one of the three dryad sisters merged into Trostani on Ravnica, who became its central head and organized the Karlov Manor murders.

bio.text: Oba was a wild, lively dryad sister of Cim and Ses, and the three were bound to an oak by Suniel and fused with the World Tree, creating Trostani.

citations.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: During the Invasion Oba secretly embodied Vitu-Ghazi to protect it from corruption, took the corruption of Realmbreaker into herself, witnessed profiteers, and resolved to cleanse Ravnica.

citations.text: "Trostani", section "Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction

bio.text: Afterward she became the center of Trostani and used pollen from flowers grown from Vitu-Ghazi's roots to put citizens in a fugue state and make them kill her targets, including Zegana, Teysa Karlov and, accidentally, Kylox.

bio.text: Alquist Proft revealed her as the mastermind, and she confessed to the killings, saying she was the heart of Ravnica betrayed by its guilds, then attacked the guild leaders, separating from her sisters and drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul.

citations.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Suniel advises the dryad sisters to seek direct contact with the Worldsoul and devises a theory to bind them to a tree.
timeline.quote: He advised them to try to achieve direct contact with the Worldsoul

citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Suniel binds the sisters' essence within a tree and they reach the Worldsoul, who commands them to grow an army.
timeline.quote: Suniel bound their essence within a tree

citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mat'Selesnya completes the spell, bonding the dryads to all trees of Ravnica; Suniel cannot save them.
timeline.quote: watch helplessly as the three sisters disappeared into the oaks

citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Three dryad sisters, Cim, Oba and Ses, try to make contact with Mat'Selesnya in a trance and report that she is in a giant web but cannot be reached.
timeline.quote: She's there in that giant web, I know it.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Suniel proposes binding the dryads to a tree so they can draw power to reach the Lattice.
timeline.quote: I have an idea,

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Suniel binds the sisters to the roots of an oak; they enter the Lattice and reach each other's minds.
timeline.quote: Then Suniel's magic flowed into them.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mat'Selesnya warns that the sisters will bond with all the trees of Ravnica and can never return; Cim agrees.
timeline.quote: Cim looked at her sisters. "We understand, Great Mother."

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The roots absorb the three dryads into the oaks while Suniel watches helplessly.
timeline.quote: watch helplessly as the three sisters disappeared into the oaks.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The three dryads appear grown from the World Tree in the great hall of Vitu-Ghazi as the new guildmaster, and Suniel realizes the Cim he knew is no more.
timeline.quote: Little did they know that they would gaze upon their new guildmaster for the first time.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The three dryad sisters enter a trance to reconnect with Mat'Selesnya; Suniel binds them to an old oak and the Parun fuses them with the World Tree, creating Trostani.
timeline.quote: this old Parun fused the three dryads with the World Tree, creating Trostani.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Creation of Trostani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mistress Cim awakes and persuades Mistress Ses to restore Trostani's harmony, and Selesnya joins the other guilds against Bolas.
timeline.quote: It is the will of Mat'Selesnya that the Conclave join the other guilds to defeat Nicol Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Oba becomes the primary aspect of Trostani and lends strength to Vitu-Ghazi after its damage in the War of the Spark and the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Oba, the dryad of life, became the primary aspect of Trostani, lending her strength to the tree

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trostani commits a series of murders of prominent Ravnicans with mind-controlling spores; Oba is subdued by her sisters and control returns to Emmara.
timeline.quote: After Oba was subdued by her sisters, Trostani stepped back to confer with Mat'Selesnya, returning control of the guild to Emmara Tandris.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Invasion Oba secretly embodies Vitu-Ghazi to protect it from corruption, witnesses profiteers, and resolves to cleanse Ravnica.
timeline.quote: She came to believe that Ravnica needed to be cleansed of these profiteers, and hatched a plan to do so.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft reveals Oba organized the murders; Oba attacks and captures Lavinia, who is freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
timeline.quote: Lavinia was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba attacks the gathered guild leaders and is captured.
timeline.quote: Oba attacks the gathered assembly

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trostani appears as three dryads from the oak and agrees to let Kaya consult the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Three dryads, each one an individual, and collectively the singular entity through which the Worldsoul of Ravnica was said to speak.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba rebukes Kaya, noting deaths occurred while she was gone.
timeline.quote: Like all the deaths while you were gone?

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Trostani's three faces show conflicting reactions.
timeline.quote: She said nothing, only continued looking back, the expressions on her three faces completely out of alignment.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba breaks her calm and admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it.
timeline.quote: Because they deserved it

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba justifies the killings by claiming to be the heart of Ravnica betrayed by its guilds.
timeline.quote: We are the green and growing heart of this plane, and without us, there would be no Ravnica, no city, no guilds!

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: I've been killing for weeks

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: Farther and farther from them she pulled herself, until she was, while still attached to the tree itself, an entirely independent entity, Trostani no longer.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: after what Oba had admitted, she'd known the dryad had to die.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba hoists Kaya and Kellan into the air as the ceiling opens.
timeline.quote: Above them, the ceiling opened like an iris, branches pulling apart to reveal an oblong section of sky.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Oba is drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul itself.
timeline.quote: She was drawing directly on the Ravnican Worldsoul, Mat'Selesnya, ripping strength from the very plane and using it against the people she had designated her enemies.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: Kaya called the Blind Eternities, asking them not for an exit but for an escape

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: Oba howled fury and disbelief as Kaya, still semi-solid, landed lightly on the floor of Vitu-Ghazi

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: And I say a Ravnica that chooses one side over another is no Ravnica at all.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: But this face of Trostani was responsible for Teysa's death

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.quote: This time when she tried to phase, the roots passed right through her.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, Oba is revealed as the organizer of the murders and attacks the guild leaders; Judith runs but is stopped by Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Judith ran away

citation.text: "Judith", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya defends herself from Oba and helps trap her in an Agency barrier ward.
timeline.quote: managed with the help of Etrata and the ghost of Teysa to trap Oba in an Agency barrier ward

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals Oba as the killer; Oba attacks and Kellan is flung from the ceiling and discovers he can fly, before Trostani is subdued by Kaya and Etrata.
timeline.quote: After Trostani was subdued by Kaya and Etrata, Kellan returned to his desk at the Agency.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals that Oba organized the murders; Krenko is captured when Oba attacks but freed after Kaya and Etrata defeat her, then arrested by Aurelia.
timeline.quote: He was later arrested by Aurelia

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Released at Vitu-Ghazi where Oba is revealed as mastermind, she escapes with Judith, then attacks and takes Judith hostage on learning of her ploy.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl attacked Judith with a knife and took her hostage.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet devises the Omenpath Project and enlists guild representatives; Kylox is killed amid Oba's murders.
timeline.quote: The Firemind enlisted representatives from each of the guilds to research the portals and their passage.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba reveals she was behind the murders, including Kylox's, and attacks the guild leaders; Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
timeline.quote: He was rescued after Kaya and Etrata defeated Oba.

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft deduces a mind-controlled hitman killed Teysa through a plant cultivated by Oba, because of her perceived collaboration with the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: The guild leader was targeted because of her perceived collaboration with the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vitu-Ghazi is replanted in a Selesnya park and the dryads change positions, with Oba at the center.
timeline.quote: Vitu-Ghazi was replanted in a Selesnya park, and Trostani moved along with it.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba uses pollen from flowers sprouted from Vitu-Ghazi's roots to put citizens in a fugue state and make them kill her targets anonymously.
timeline.quote: transforming them into lethal weapons with which to slay her targets anonymously.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba brainwashes Etrata into killing Zegana, drawing media attention and the detective Alquist Proft.
timeline.quote: when she brainwashed Etrata into killing Zegana , the case began to attract media attention

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba gets away with the murder of Teysa Karlov and accidentally kills Kylox.
timeline.quote: Oba managed to get away with the murder of Teysa Karlov and accidentally killed Kylox .

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals at Vitu-Ghazi that Oba organized the murders as retribution against those she considered traitors.
timeline.quote: Proft revealed that Trostani — specifically Oba — was responsible for organizing the murders

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba resists arrest, renders her sisters unconscious, animates Vitu-Ghazi and attacks the guild leaders, seriously injuring Etrata.
timeline.quote: She animated Vitu-Ghazi and attacked the guild leaders, seriously injuring Etrata.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, with Etrata's help, traps Oba within barrier wards and her sisters render her unconscious.
timeline.quote: trapping Oba within barrier wards, giving her sisters time to render her unconscious.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft reveals at Vitu-Ghazi that Oba organized the murders; Oba attacks and captures Vannifar, who is freed after Kaya and Etrata defeat Oba.
timeline.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Vannifar was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, Proft reveals Oba organized the murders; Oba captures Ezrim, who is freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
timeline.quote: Ezrim was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata

citation.text: "Ezrim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, Proft reveals Trostani organized the murders in retribution for traitors during the Invasion; when Oba attacks the guild leaders, Izoni fights back.
timeline.quote: Izoni fought back instead of running away.

citation.text: "Izoni", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals Oba as the mastermind; Oba justifies Kylox's killing by his Phyrexian technology work.
timeline.quote: she justified Kylox's killing by blaming his work with Phyrexian technology

citation.text: "Kylox", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft gathers the guild leaders and reveals Oba as the killer; Oba confesses her motives.
timeline.quote: revealed the killer as Oba, the central dryad of Trostani

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba attacks the assembly and kills Tolsimir Wolfblood but is captured by Kaya and Etrata with Teysa's ghost.
timeline.quote: killing Tolsimir Wolfblood

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zegana is assassinated at a celebration at Karlov Manor; Alquist Proft deduces Etrata, mind-controlled by a plant of Oba, was the killer.
timeline.quote: Zegana was assassinated during a celebration at Karlov Manor
